TextView.android:text: Terrain data makes marker positions more accurate. Import one .zip file for each area. A second import of the same area replaces the first.

The flight screen shows the FAA altitude ceiling at your position. Download the data on Wi-Fi before you go.\n\n⚠ This is advice only. It is NOT an authorization to fly, and it does not change the max altitude of the aircraft.
Hybrid shows satellite pictures with street names. Custom shows the map server of your team.
Save the custom map of an area on this controller. The flight screen then shows the map with no network. Use Wi-Fi for the download.
